missing_return_main: zero underlying return and assumed liquidation, same accounting as prior profitability analysis
missing_return_sensitivity: underlying -100% on unknown longs, +100% on unknown shorts
no_indicator_policy: risk-free cash; retain the full calendar and flag availability explicitly
single_sides: separately rebalanced +100% long and -100% short books; positive short return means short profit
active_funding: no collateral interest or cash funding in active factor months, same as previous profitability books
regime_cost_policy: map continuously rebalanced net monthly returns into the gated calendar; regime switching turnover not recomputed
ic: Spearman correlation; cosine on internal score/50-1; cosine on formation-centered composite ranks; observed outcomes only, minimum 100
